notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
New content

Added infinity mode after you complete a run, where the difficulty ramps up and you can play until you lose

Added 8 new relics



Gameplay and quality of life changes

Added the ability to see the full Pantheon during a run (book icon on the bottom right).

Differentiation between acquired and recruited (some gods that said “god recruited” are now “god acquired”, and also trigger when you acquire another god)



Balance Changes

Japanese were by far the strongest and most consistent mythology, so they are getting some nerfs. Additionally, some mythologies that were underperforming are getting buffs.

Gods

Some gods’ stats have been changed, I’ll only detail ability and tier changes

Nabu moved to Tier II, now requires 2 essence and gives 2 essence

Airmed now gives +4/+3

Ame no Uzume moved to Tier II

Ninhursag moved to tier I

Sarutahiko moved to tier I, now only gets +1/+1 per SP

Amaterasu moved to tier III

Cailleach now gives +2/+1 to allies when dismissed

Hachiman moved to tier II (and has his stats reduced)

Heimdall only damages allies (this is intended to help Norse against Cthulhu, which is by far their worst matchup)

Artemis now gets +2/+2 on kill

Ogun now also has Cleave himself

Athena now affects all allies

Bai Ze now gives +2/+1

Kagutsuchi now only buffs attack

Susanoo now only buffs attack

Enlil now also buffs gods on the bench

Ares now gets +8 attack

Morrigan now gives +2 defense

Cernunnos now has “Dimiss: get a Celtic god and refresh the pantheon with Celtics”



Relics

Sudharshana chakra: now only gives attack

Khryselakatos: now also gives all your gods +1 defense

Tengu Fan: now only gives +1 SP

Dark Medal: now gives +3/+3



Blessings

Inversion: now also gives your gods +1/+1

Glorious flow: now gives +4/+4

Illumination: now updates your gods by 2 tiers

Radiant weapon: now gives +5 attack

Radiant defender: now is a 17/17

Radiant commendation: now gives +13/+13

Radiant armor: now gives +5 defense

Radiant flow: now gives +10/+10

Radiant spark: now gives 5 essence

Oath reaffirmation: moved to tier 3 (golden blessing)

Exalted weapon now gives 8 attack

Exalted defender now gives you a 30/30

Exalted armor now gives 8 defense

Exalted growth now +9/+9

Exalted commendation now gives +20/+20

Exalted flow: now gives +20/+20

Essence preservation: moved to tier 2 (silver blessing)

notes.title: Quality of life and bugfixes update
notes.notes:
First of all, I want to thank you for your help and support. The release went better than I expected, and I'm very grateful.

I'm working on improving the game. Here are some of the changes you can expect in the near future:
[olist]
 Quality of life improvements and bug fixes based on your feedback. This update just went live (more details below)
 Balance changes, which may take a bit longer to get to Steam (in 1-2 weeks).
 A small content update, with some new relics (in 1 month).
[/olist]

Here are the changes:
Quality of life:

 Hovering over a unit now shows its mythology
 Casual mode difficulty is now unlocked from the start
 You can now freeze gods with a right click while targeting (helpful with Spirit of Desire)
 Made the triple effect for gods of all mythologies (including the Unity blessing) more visible
 Added a light highlight when you find a second copy of a god in the Pantheon
 Star chart can no longer appear as the first relic option (instantly prompting you to select the mythologies even if you don't want it)
 Mortal uprising can no longer appear after you pick Divine purge (not that it was a good idea picking it)
 The mythology substituted by mythology-specific relics is now random
 Added 1.5x (by popular demand)
 Added the relic crowns that show which relics have led you to victory to the Pantheon mode
 Improved the attack animations
 Removed Earth defender from the pool of cards you can randomly get from Living Whirlwind
 Casual level is now remembered for each enemy


Bug fixes:

 Anu and Tezcatlipoca now work with blessings and relics
 Fixed a bug that caused Sacrificial Shade to not work sometimes
 Cthulhu's counter now resets after trigger (also added an animation for the effect)
 Fixed a bug that made the "Relic master" achievement not unlock. You will have to win a run to unlock it.
 Fixed the order of attacking with the blessing Primordial echo
 Twin elevation now triggers for all pairs when you pick it up
 Fixed a bug that caused the 3rd shield to not show up (if you have Aegis shield and Sacred barrier)
 Fixed the display of related gods while discovering (for example, Khnum)
 Fixed a bug that caused Echo elemental to trigger on gods that you'd dismissed
 Fixed a bug that caused Exalted elevation to remove acquired abilities (like ethereal shield or fury)
 Fixed a bug that caused enemies to attack between your attacks when you had fury and first strike
 Fixed the interaction between Celestial chains and Divine alignment
 Fixed a bug that caused defeats to count as victories for the achievement (this won't take away your crowns)

notes.title: Demo update for Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
The demo is being updated for Steam Next Fest and some of the content will be available exclusively during the festival. Here’s what’s coming:

 A New Boss: Face Arachnomir (Next Fest Exclusive), an eldritch spider that summons new enemies.
 A New Unlockable Mythology: Expanding the roster from 5 to 6, offering fresh strategic possibilities and Godly synergies.
 Blessings Mechanic: Receive powerful buffs at key moments during your run, adding new layers of decision-making.
 Controller Support: Now you can play the demo on the Steam Deck or using your controller.


You can play the demo here, and if you like it please Wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3079080/Gods_vs_Horrors_Demo/
